hero.title: Welcome to Harar
hero.subtitle: The City of Peace and Heritage

unesco.title: Harar: The City of Peace
unesco.description: Once known as Harla, Harar stands as one of the world's oldest Islamic cities, where centuries of faith, culture, and heritage converge within the legendary Jegol Wall.
unesco.mosques: Mosques in just 48 hectares, including the 800-year-old Al-Jami Mosque
unesco.wall: Jegol Wall with 365 alleyways – one for each day of the year
unesco.gates: Symbolizing the Five Pillars of Islam, connecting sacred neighborhoods
unesco.recognition: UNESCO recognition as the "City of Peace"

gates.title: The Sacred Gates
gates.description: Five entrances to a city steeped in spiritual heritage

architecture.title: Architectural Devotion
architecture.description: Harar's architecture reflects deep respect for faith. Mosque entrances are intentionally low, encouraging worshippers to bow symbolically as they enter – a physical manifestation of spiritual humility.

independence.title: Independent Islamic State
independence.description: Until 1887, Harar flourished as an independent Islamic state, minting its own historic coins and maintaining diplomatic relations. Turkey established the first foreign embassy here, recognizing Harar's significance on the world stage.

battle.title: Battle of Chelenko
battle.description: In 1887, following the Battle of Chelenko, Harar joined Ethiopia, beginning a new chapter while preserving its unique cultural and spiritual identity that continues to captivate visitors today.

heritage.livingDesc: Where ancient traditions meet daily life
heritage.treasuresDesc: A tapestry of faith, art, and community

nature.description: Explore Harar's surrounding landscapes and green valleys. Discover the natural beauty of the Ethiopian highlands with guided nature walks and scenic viewpoints.

cultural.title: Cultural Experience
cultural.description: Learn Harari traditions, festivals, and daily lifestyle. Participate in traditional coffee ceremonies, witness colorful festivals, and engage with local communities.

adventure.title: Outdoor and Adventure
adventure.description: Experience hiking, local markets, and the famous hyena feeding. Join evening hyena feeding sessions and explore bustling traditional markets filled with spices and crafts.

education.title: Research and Educational Travel
education.description: Visit museums and historical archives for cultural studies. Access rare manuscripts, historical documents, and learn about Islamic heritage and Harari history.

guide.title: Need a Guide?
